content:
I have been using the iPhone Duo for a bit over a month, and it has easily become my favorite tech product of 2026. Every time I use it, I feel an excitement that only comes from a product category this new. But because it’s so new and the form factor is something we have not seen from Apple, accessories for the Duo have been all over the place. It’s the Wild West for new cases and iPhone Duo accessories, and I love that! I have been testing a ton of new accessories, from different cases to perfectly contoured MagSafe battery packs and everything in between. These are some of my favorite accessories that every iPhone Duo needs to try out, especially with Black Friday season here!
